arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND c.card_type = 'Debit'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions over $1,000 made on debit cards, excluding prepaid debit cards.
assumptions: 'Over 1000 dollars' means amount_usd_cents > 100000 (amounts are stored in cents).
The count includes all transactions, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
